svg.data-cable-capacity-basis: ESTIMATE, not stated by FS - Cat6 24AWG (6.1 mm). A channel cross-section of 60.6 x 112.2 mm (6799.3 mm2) at 47.7 mm2 a cable, the median of FS's own Cat6 counts for ten horizontal finger ducts, rounded down (see provenance `capacity`)
